summary: E2E frontend verification of 4 new features on Fikirizm Cloud (Settings unification, notification prefs, draggable/promotable subtasks, activity badge). All 4 features work end-to-end. Backend changes were already curl-verified by main agent.

issues: Radix a11y console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' — pre-existing, non-blocking

other.issue: WebSocket /api/ws/... handshake returns 403 in preview (polling fallback works). Confirmed out-of-scope per request.

verified_features: Login as owner ingobiosport@gmail.com works, dashboard loads.
Sidebar shows nav-settings ('Ayarlar') and NO nav-mail-settings link. No 'Mail Ayarları' text in sidebar.
GET /ayarlar/mail redirects to /ayarlar (verified URL after navigation).
/ayarlar shows all 4 tabs: tab-profile, tab-notifications, tab-mail, tab-workspace.
Profile tab: edited profile-name-input ('Fikirizm Yöneticisi' -> '... T'), Kaydet persists after reload; reverted to original.
Mail tab: smtp-host, smtp-port, smtp-user, smtp-pass, from-email, from-name, smtp-tls-switch, mail-save-btn all visible. 'Emergent' text NOT present anywhere on tab. No provider dropdown exists.

Notifications tab: notif-assign-switch, notif-budget-switch, notif-reminder-switch, notif-save-btn visible. Toggling assign switch (checked -> unchecked) and muting one project persisted after reload (GET /settings/notifications reflects saved state). Reverted after test.
Workspace tab: org-name-input + ws-name-input + workspace-save-btn. Saved 'Fikirizm X' / 'Fikirizm Ekibi X', persisted after reload. Reverted to original.

TaskDrawer subtasks: added 2 subtasks via subtask-input. Each row has subtask-drag-<id> handle (GripVertical) and subtask-promote-<id> button. Clicking promote on last added subtask removed it from subtasks list and it appeared as a top-level card ('TEST subtask 1 ...') in the Ürün Geliştirme project (verified via Pano view screenshot).

Activity badge: sidebar showed activity-badge with count '3' on initial load. After navigating to /aktivite, localStorage 'fik_activity_seen' was set to an ISO timestamp; navigating away and back showed badge cleared (element removed from DOM).
